thread:
Meera Patel: FYI I reproduced a client that aggressively replays mid-stream when the edge demotes fastpath->slowpath. It caused double side-effects on an internal webhook.
Omar Khan: rough trace? sounds like the gateway handed off and upstream then reset the TCP conn?
Meera Patel: simplified trace:
```
CLIENT -> EDGE: POST /v1/events (streaming body)
EDGE: accepts, routes via fastpath
EDGE: fastpath detects resource pressure, transfers to slowpath at t=8.7s
UPSTREAM: downstream returned 200 then connection reset during trailer flush
CLIENT: immediate retry same request (no idempotency header)
```
Laura Chen: if we allow client-origin retries mid-stream without idempotency, we'll replay side effects. We need deterministic policy at the gateway boundary.
Ben Hsu: proposal: gateway should emit `X-Edge-Retry-Origin: gateway|client|upstream` and `X-Edge-Retry-Id: <uuid>` when the gateway itself retries or resumes a stream. For client-origin retries, if they come mid-stream with no Idempotency-Key, gateway should reject with 409 and a machine-readable hint.
Omar Khan: +1 on headers but call them `X-Edge-Retry-Origin` to avoid colliding with SDK heuristics. Implementation constraints: we can't buffer arbitrary large streaming bodies to replay. Gateway-origin resume only works with resumable tokens (stream offset + KV checkpoint).
Meera Patel: concrete rules I want in the follow-up RFC: 1) Pre-commit retries (only headers): gateway coalesces if same idempotency key or same connection id. 2) Mid-stream client retry w/out idempotency -> responder 409 with JSON {"error":"retry_requires_idempotency","docs":"/edge/retries"} and header `X-Edge-Retry-Allowed: false`. 3) Gateway-initiated resumes include `X-Edge-Retry-Origin: gateway` and `X-Edge-Retry-Id: uuid` and `X-Edge-Retry-TTL: 30` (seconds).
Laura Chen: small bikeshed: should we use 422 for semantic issue? 409 makes sense for concurrent modification semantics; either works if we document. SDKs should surface the `retry_requires_idempotency` code.
Ben Hsu: let's also instrument metrics: `edge.retry.origin.gateway`, `edge.retry.origin.client`, `edge.retry.origin.upstream`, `edge.retry.rejected_midstream_no_idempotency`. And add logs that include `retry_id` when set.
Omar Khan: operational note: when gateway emits `X-Edge-Retry-Id` we must garbage collect resume state after TTL. Recommend TTL=30s default, configurable per route. Also add a small ingress cache size guard to avoid OOM from many partial streams.
Meera Patel: test plan: unit tests for header propagation, integration test that simulates fastpath->slowpath transfer with a streaming body and asserts we either tolerate gateway resume (with headers) or reject client replay with 409 and helpful body. I'll include curl examples in the RFC and a tiny node/python SDK snippet showing recommended client behavior.
ci-bot: merge queued: feature/edge-retry-annotate (PR #4278) — tests passing :white_check_mark:
Omar Khan: implementation doc should also show a migration path for SDKs: 1) detect 409+retry_requires_idempotency -> automatically surface error and suggest attaching Idempotency-Key; 2) when SDK retries, include Idempotency-Key and tolerate 409 by backing off.
Meera Patel: thanks. I'll write the RFC follow-up and attach sample traces and test harness results. tagging eng/runtime and eng-platform for review. :pray:
